items: Adjust the glass and belt moulding contact with the trim support.
Slide the glass back and forth and adjust the fore and aft positions of the upper glass guide tip.
Adjust the glass tilt angle by tilting the equalizer installation.
Adjust the upper glass contact with the two adjusting bolts of glass guide tip.
Adjust the upper position of the glass with the fore and aft upper stoppers.

With the door glass fully closed, adjust the glass plate so the inner stabilizer lightly makes contact with it. After these adjustments are completed, adjust the front lower frame with the lower bolt so that there is a proper fit between the front pillar and glass.
